INSERT INTO ultary_story ( user_no, file_id, media_type, thumbnail_file_id, duration_sec, caption, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{fileId}, #{mediaType}, #{thumbnailFileId}, #{durationSec}, #{caption},
'2099-12-31 23:59:59' )

INSERT INTO ultary_story_text ( story_id, content, font_size, is_bold, is_underline, is_strikethrough, color, pos_x, pos_y, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{storyId}, #{content}, #{fontSize}, #{bold}, #{underline}, #{strikethrough}, #{color}, #{posX}, #{posY}, #{sortOrder} )
INSERT INTO ultary_story_mention ( story_id, pet_id, pos_x, pos_y, sort_order, added_by_user_no ) VALUES ( #{storyId}, #{petId}, #{posX}, #{posY}, #{sortOrder}, #{addedByUserNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT story_text_id, story_id, content, font_size, is_bold AS bold, is_underline AS underline, is_strikethrough AS strikethrough, color, pos_x, pos_y, sort_order FROM ultary_story_text WHERE story_id = #{storyId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, story_text_id ASC

SELECT sm.story_mention_id, sm.story_id, sm.pet_id, p.mention_id, p.name AS petName, sm.pos_x, sm.pos_y, sm.sort_order, sm.added_by_user_no FROM ultary_story_mention sm LEFT JOIN ultary_pet p ON p.pet_id = sm.pet_id WHERE sm.story_id = #{storyId} ORDER BY sm.sort_order ASC, sm.story_mention_id ASC

SELECT FROM ultary_story WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND ORDER BY created_at ASC, story_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_story WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND

SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname AS nickname, ( SELECT rp.profile_file_id FROM ultary_pet rp WHERE rp.user_no = u.user_no AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.profile_file_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rp.priority ASC, rp.pet_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS profileFileId, COUNT(s.story_id) AS storyCount FROM ultary_neighbor n INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = n.receiver_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN ultary_story s ON s.user_no = u.user_no AND s.is_deleted = 0
WHERE n.requester_user_no = #{viewerUserNo} AND n.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_user_privacy p WHERE p.user_no = u.user_no AND p.story_visibility = 'PRIVATE' ) GROUP BY u.user_no, u.nickname ORDER BY MAX(s.created_at) DESC
SELECT story_like_id, story_id, user_no, created_at, is_deleted, deleted_at FROM ultary_story_like WHERE story_id = #{storyId} AND user_no = #{userNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_story_like (story_id, user_no, is_deleted, deleted_at) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{userNo}, 0, NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE ultary_story_like SET is_deleted = 0, deleted_at = NULL, created_at = NOW() WHERE story_id = #{storyId} AND user_no = #{userNo} AND is_deleted = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_story_like WHERE story_id = #{storyId} AND is_deleted = 0
